bio: Tethered to this mortal plane by an ancient hex, Vagur cuts a tragic figure. He emerged from the crypts beneath Shadespire, howling about an undead monarch whose return threatens all of Amara. Is Vagur an emissary of this king, or someone sent to warn of their return? This answer remains a mystery - for all those who have asked have ended up skewered on Vagur's soul-draining blade.
